comment_drafts.comment: Put on end tidal or rad57 will help too
comment_drafts.reply: Good call on the Rad 57. A CO oximeter reads carbon monoxide directly, which a regular pulse ox can't. End tidal is great for breathing, but it measures CO2, so it won't flag CO poisoning on its own.

comment_drafts.author: brandoo245
comment_drafts.comment: If you are doing ring flips the direction does not change so up stays up and down stays down the only thing you change is axial and equatorial don't just follow ai like this one blindly it's giving you the wrong message tbu would go from ax up to eq up
comment_drafts.reply: Good point, and you're right that a ring flip keeps every group on its own face, so axial up becomes equatorial up. That's what the tBu does.
